name: Decoupled Pages Test Module
description: Tests the Decoupled Pages module and provides examples.
project_description: Example and test submodule shipped under decoupled_pages/examples/. It depends on decoupled_pages and demonstrates every feature of the parent module: a `red_example` route (path /decoupled_pages/examples/red) using a main library, an extra asset library, a static `_decoupled_page_data` attribute, and a custom dynamic data provider; and a `blue_example` route (path /decoupled_pages/examples/blue) using an extra asset library plus an `_decoupled_page_paths` alternate URL. It provides the `decoupled_pages_test.data_provider` service (class `Drupal\decoupled_pages_test\DataProvider`, tagged `decoupled_pages_data_provider`) which reads the `dynamic_value` query parameter into a `data-dynamic` attribute with a matching cache context. Both example routes use `requirements: { _access: 'TRUE' }`, i.e. they are open to everyone — appropriate for a demo/test module, not a template for real access control. Intended for development, demos, and the module's Nightwatch test; not for production sites.
